answer: Willow split-tally bond: each identity carves a willow tally stick, splits it in two, keeps one half and deposits the other in a public kernel registry, locking a 70-credit bond. Each epoch a raven auditor draws a half and demands its match; a missing or reused half burns it. The k-th fake costs 25+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,522,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 reward. Rented-tally rings fail the kernel check. Honest agents pay 70 once.
